title: The Visitor Log
hook: Night desk rule at the hospital: if a visitor signs in with a patient's name, you do not let them up.
lines: My first night on the hospital front desk, the old guard slid the visitor log across to me.
After two a.m., everyone signs in. Everyone.
And if someone signs a patient's name... instead of their own... you do not let them up.
For three weeks, that log stayed empty. Just humming lights, and rain against the glass doors.
Then, at two-fifteen, the doors slid open.
An old woman shuffled in. Barefoot. Soaking wet. A hospital bracelet on her wrist.
She signed the log without a word... and smiled at me.
I checked the screen. Ruth Ellery was upstairs. Fourth floor. Asleep.
I'm sorry, ma'am... I can't let you up.
Her smile went away. She turned... and walked back out into the rain.
At three, the fourth floor called down. Ruth Ellery had passed away... in her sleep.
At dawn, I went to close the log. Under her name, in the same shaky handwriting, was a second line.
